tool.name: Docker MCP Gateway
tool.description: Open-source docker mcp CLI plugin that proxies MCP servers run in isolated containers, with central secrets, OAuth and call tracing.
strengths: Runs MCP servers in isolated containers
Shareable server profiles via OCI registries
tool.statusNote: The OSS CLI plugin is generally available; the MCP Gateway as part of Docker AI Governance is invite-only (as of 2026-09-30).
tool.practitionerNote: A good fit for developer workstations and CI that already use Docker Desktop, because MCP servers run sandboxed instead of as raw npx/uvx processes. Central org-wide policy needs the invite-only Docker AI Governance offering.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Runs locally or on operator hosts via Docker; MCP servers execute in local containers.

deployment.detail: Runs in Docker Desktop via MCP Toolkit, or as a standalone CLI plugin binary.

auditLogging.detail: Built-in logging and call tracing of MCP operations; no dedicated audit-log store documented.

soc2.detail: Self-hosted OSS CLI; SOC 2 applies to the operator's infrastructure, not the package.

iso27001.detail: Self-hosted OSS CLI; ISO 27001 applies to the operator's ISMS, not the package.

iso42001.detail: Self-hosted OSS CLI; ISO 42001 applies to the deploying organisation.

euAiAct.detail: MCP proxy tooling, not an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with the deployer.
